title: The third visitor
venue: Arthur's site (newspaper cadence: six dailies + a Sunday)
logline: Monday, week three. A comment. One line. From Boise. The third visitor has a city. Wood draws Boise as a shape on a map he's never seen, like Seattle in 1999.

panels.composition: The bedroom. The CRT: a comment. One line. WOOD reading it three times. BARNABY.

image.prompt: brush-pen line with muddy early-digital flats, a young man leaning toward a CRT reading a single line of text three times, a small dog on the bed
image.notes: Letter after, the comment: 'the dog is good. —boise'

panels.composition: The screen: 'the dog is good. —boise'. Lowercase. That's all.

image.prompt: brush-pen line with muddy early-digital flats, close-up of a CRT showing a short lowercase comment beneath a comic strip

panels.composition: Wood drawing on the pad: a map. Oregon, roughly. Idaho, guessed. A dot: BOISE. The way he drew Seattle in 1999 — a city he's never seen, for someone.

image.prompt: brush-pen line with muddy early-digital flats, a young man drawing a rough map of two states with a dot labelled in a city he has never seen
image.notes: Rhymes with the 1999 map. Letter after: BOISE, with a question mark he crosses out.

panels.composition: At the back of the panel, faint, for the first time in this run: one stick figure. Small. Standing in Boise, on the map, looking at the dog.

image.prompt: brush-pen line with muddy early-digital flats, a single faint crude stick figure standing on a hand-drawn map beside a dot, looking toward a small dog on a bed, no words
image.notes: The chorus's first member. One. Boise. (dw_2004-01-13 has two; this is the first alone, six days earlier — reconcile: this is the first, the 13th's two are the second and him.)

art.line: brush-pen scanned; muddy early-digital flats begin
art.palette: limited, muddy; Sundays in over-wet watercolor

notes: 'the dog is good. —boise.' The first stick figure, on a map.
